verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships an official MCP server. The GitHub README cites MCP integration for direct connection to AI tools like Claude Code, and the official self-hosting docs have a dedicated MCP section. It runs as part of the Dockerized FastAPI server, and community posts reference MCP setups for Cursor and Claude without contradicting it. Missing for 10: detail on exposed MCP tools and transport, first-party connection instructions in the pack, and independent hands-on confirmation (community notes setup is hard for newcomers).
